topic: rendering a Remotion video from the command line
angle: One CLI command renders a Remotion composition to a video file.

claims.text: `npx remotion render` followed by the composition id renders a video from the command line.
The Remotion docs page for the render command lists the options you can pass.
Remotion describes itself as a way to make videos programmatically (its home page headline reads "Make videos programmatically").
